text:
Response A is more accurate and more concise. It correctly states the v1 shutdown moved from 30 November to 31 January 2027, keeps the 8% figure and the 15-minute switch time, and lists the key changes and fixes with specifics. It is probably a little over 120 words, but it stays close.

Response B has a significant accuracy problem. It says the new features are "enabled automatically... so no action is needed," but the source says the area-based shift swap approvals must be set up in Admin > Permissions > Areas. It also pads the summary with filler ("Thank you for taking the time...", "we kindly ask") and runs well past 120 words. Its "Also" section drops the specifics a manager would need.

Both omit the staff-facing detail that notifications can be turned off and the "staff could be paid late" consequence, but Response A's omissions are less serious than Response B's misstatement and length.

Verdict: A
